decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - 3. B5 (The proposed development shall be carried out in all respect in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and amended drawings no. KFC/2130/02RevA submitted 8th July 2008 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority).
Condition : 4 - 4.The use hereby permitted for take away (A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 11am to 11pm Monday to Sunday.
Condition : 5 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 11am and 11pm.

Condition : 6 - 5.	A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 7 - 6.	Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No KFC/2130/02 and No.KFC/2130/02RevA and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Demolition of rear single storey extension and the erection of a new single storey extension and staircase enclosure to the building
